pendentes.titulo: SSD chegando ao fim: como saber antes de perder os arquivos
pendentes.alt: SSD do tipo M.2 sobre uma bancada, ao lado de um notebook virado com a tampa inferior removida
pendentes.pedido: A plain black M.2 solid state drive without any sticker lying on a grey anti-static mat on a wooden workbench, seen from a low three-quarter angle. Behind it, slightly out of focus, a generic dark laptop turned upside down with its bottom cover removed, showing the internal boards. A small precision screwdriver rests beside the drive. Soft daylight from a window on the left, shallow depth of field.
